project: Use the left and right arrow keys to move. up arrow to jump.
Some blocks are fake, just like these yellow ones.
Tiles with skulls will kill you and falling off screen will too
Tiles with arrows allow you to jump higher
Touch the tile with a question mark to reach the goal

Danger abounds and it isn't always apparent.  Try and complete all of the levels while losing as few stickmen as possible.

Use the arrow keys or WAD keys on the keyboard or the on-screen buttons on touch devices to control the stickman.

Progress is saved at the end of each level.  If you want to reset the game and any progress you've made, press the Clear Progress button after clicking the Play button.  The Clear Progress button won't show up if you haven't completed the first level.
